Good native plants for Ohio include:

- Wild columbine: spring flowers; partial shade
- Butterfly milkweed: orange blooms; full sun; supports monarchs
- Purple coneflower: long-blooming; full sun to light shade
- Wild bergamot: fragrant flowers; attracts bees and butterflies
- Black-eyed Susan: cheerful yellow blooms; tolerates poor soil
- Cardinal flower: red blooms; moist soil; attracts hummingbirds
- Switchgrass: ornamental native grass; provides wildlife cover
- Serviceberry: spring flowers and edible berries
- Eastern redbud: pink spring flowers; suitable for smaller yards
- White oak: long-lived shade tree; valuable to native wildlife
